<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Privacy policy · Omenix</title>
<meta name="description" content="Omenix is a private research dashboard for stock and F&O research and paper trading. It is run by one person, its owner, for their own use and for the few people they invite. This page says what data Omenix uses, why, and who else sees it.">
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64,">
<style>
/* Omenix cockpit: design tokens, scheme v2 "modern admin light" (2026-10-08).
   The owner asked for the look of modern admin templates (Pixinvent Materialize with its semi-dark vertical
   menu, Aurora) applied to a broker-style cockpit: a soft light-grey page, white cards lifted by a faint shadow
   (no hairline borders), one periwinkle-indigo accent, a dark navy sidebar with labels, icon tiles on the KPI
   cards, gradient area charts, generous spacing. Token names keep the Material role vocabulary
   (--md-sys-color-*) so components.css and every page need no renaming; the previous scheme ("terminal
   light") used the same names with other values.
   Verdict rule (owner): NO is red; YES is green, darker green for a strong signal, lighter green for an okay
   one. Up/down/hit/miss always carry a glyph and a word. Text tones are AA on white (figures in the comments);
   the vivid template tones live on fills and tints with a dark ink on them.
   Self-contained: no @import, no font files, system font stack. */
:root {
  color-scheme: light;

  /* ---- Colour roles --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --md-sys-color-primary: #5a5ee6;                 /* periwinkle indigo (5.0:1 on white) */
  --md-sys-color-on-primary: #ffffff;
  --md-sys-color-primary-container: #e9eaff;       /* accent tint: selected segment, icon tiles */
  --md-sys-color-on-primary-container: #3a3db8;    /* 7.0:1 on the tint */
  --md-sys-color-secondary: #65708a;
  --md-sys-color-on-secondary: #ffffff;
  --md-sys-color-secondary-container: #eef0f5;
  --md-sys-color-on-secondary-container: #3f4756;
  --md-sys-color-tertiary: #7c3aed;
  --md-sys-color-on-tertiary: #ffffff;
  --md-sys-color-tertiary-container: #f1ebff;      /* Paper tag */
  --md-sys-color-on-tertiary-container: #5b21b6;
  --md-sys-color-error: #dc2626;
  --md-sys-color-on-error: #ffffff;
  --md-sys-color-error-container: #fde8e8;
  --md-sys-color-on-error-container: #991b1b;
  --md-sys-color-surface: #ffffff;
  --md-sys-color-on-surface: #4b465c;              /* ink, 9.0:1 on white */
  --md-sys-color-surface-variant: #f3f4f8;
  --md-sys-color-on-surface-variant: #65708a;      /* muted labels, 5.0:1 on white */
  --md-sys-color-surface-dim: #e4e6ee;
  --md-sys-color-surface-bright: #ffffff;
  --md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest: #ffffff; /* cards */
  --md-sys-color-surface-container-low: #f7f7f9;    /* the page */
  --md-sys-color-surface-container: #f3f4f8;        /* tiles, table heads, inputs */
  --md-sys-color-surface-container-high: #eceef3;   /* table rules, dividers */
  --md-sys-color-surface-container-highest: #e4e6ee;
  --md-sys-color-outline: #a3a9b8;
  --md-sys-color-outline-variant: #e7e9ef;          /* control borders */
  --md-sys-color-inverse-surface: #2f3349;          /* tooltips, the sidebar */
  --md-sys-color-inverse-on-surface: #f4f5fa;
  --md-sys-color-inverse-primary: #b4b6ff;
  --md-sys-color-surface-tint: #5a5ee6;
  --md-sys-color-background: #f7f7f9;
  --md-sys-color-on-background: #4b465c;
  --md-sys-color-scrim: #000000;
  --md-sys-color-shadow: #2f3349;

  /* ---- Sidebar (semi-dark vertical menu) -------------------------------------------------- */
  --mb-sidebar-bg: #2f3349;
  --mb-sidebar-ink: #d7d8e5;         /* 8.8:1 on the sidebar */
  --mb-sidebar-muted: #9fa2b7;       /* 4.9:1 */
  --mb-sidebar-active: linear-gradient(72deg, #5a5ee6 0%, #7a7df0 100%);
  --mb-brand-tile: linear-gradient(to top right, #5a5ee6, #7a7df0); /* the logo tile (design/brand/), same colours as the active rail item */
  --mb-sidebar-active-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(90, 94, 230, .45);

  /* ---- Semantic tokens (finance) --------------------------------------------------------
     up/hit = green, down/miss = red; text tones 5.0:1 / 4.8:1 on white. The tints are fresher than
     before (template "label" badges): ink on tint 6.4:1 / 7.1:1 / 4.6:1. */
  --mb-color-up: #15803d;
  --mb-color-on-up: #ffffff;
  --mb-color-up-container: #e3f8e9;
  --mb-color-on-up-container: #166534;
  --mb-color-down: #dc2626;
  --mb-color-on-down: #ffffff;
  --mb-color-down-container: #fde8e8;
  --mb-color-on-down-container: #991b1b;
  --mb-color-neutral: #65708a;
  --mb-color-on-neutral: #ffffff;
  --mb-color-neutral-container: #eef0f5;
  --mb-color-on-neutral-container: #3f4756;
  --mb-color-warn: #e07b00;               /* "direction unclear", flags (icons and fills) */
  --mb-color-on-warn: #ffffff;
  --mb-color-warn-container: #fff3e0;
  --mb-color-on-warn-container: #b45309;  /* 4.6:1 on the tint, 5.0:1 on white */
  --mb-color-info: #0b8fa6;
  --mb-color-info-container: #e0f7fb;
  --mb-color-on-info-container: #0c5d6b;
  --mb-color-hit: var(--mb-color-up);
  --mb-color-hit-container: var(--mb-color-up-container);
  --mb-color-on-hit-container: var(--mb-color-on-up-container);
  --mb-color-miss: var(--mb-color-down);
  --mb-color-miss-container: var(--mb-color-down-container);
  --mb-color-on-miss-container: var(--mb-color-on-down-container);
  /* Verdict (decision header) */
  --mb-verdict-no-bg: #fde8e8;        --mb-verdict-no-box: #dc2626;    --mb-verdict-no-ink: #991b1b;
  --mb-verdict-strong-bg: #bff0cf;    --mb-verdict-strong-box: #166534; --mb-verdict-strong-ink: #14532d;
  --mb-verdict-ok-bg: #e3f8e9;        --mb-verdict-ok-box: #15803d;    --mb-verdict-ok-ink: #166534;
  /* Provenance labels: Live (green tint), Back-test (hatched accent tint), Mock (dashed), Paper (violet tint).
     Each has a texture or border style besides its colour. */
  --mb-color-live: var(--mb-color-up);
  --mb-color-live-container: var(--mb-color-up-container);
  --mb-color-on-live-container: var(--mb-color-on-up-container);
  --mb-color-backtest: var(--md-sys-color-primary);
  --mb-color-backtest-container: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(90,94,230,.14) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px);
  --mb-color-on-backtest-container: var(--md-sys-color-on-primary-container);
  --mb-color-mock: var(--md-sys-color-outline);
  --mb-color-on-mock-container: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant);
  --mb-color-paper: var(--md-sys-color-tertiary);
  --mb-color-paper-container: var(--md-sys-color-tertiary-container);
  --mb-color-on-paper-container: var(--md-sys-color-on-tertiary-container);

  /* ---- Chart tokens (dataviz skill) ------------------------------------------------------- */
  --mb-chart-surface: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest);
  --mb-chart-1: #5a5ee6;   /* series 1 = the accent: ranges, model, rule strategies, everything "ours" */
  --mb-chart-2: #e07b00;   /* series 2 (orange; 3.0:1 on white: shapes with direct labels) */
  --mb-chart-3: #0b8fa6;   /* series 3 (teal, 3.8:1) */
  --mb-chart-4: #d6338f;   /* series 4 (pink, 4.4:1) */
  --mb-chart-1-fill: rgba(90,94,230,.28);     /* gradient top of an area chart, fades to 0 */
  --mb-chart-2-fill: rgba(224,123,0,.22);
  --mb-chart-3-fill: rgba(11,143,166,.22);
  --mb-chart-band-50: rgba(90,94,230,.30);   /* inner band, series 1 */
  --mb-chart-band-80: rgba(90,94,230,.12);   /* outer band */
  --mb-chart-fan: rgba(90,94,230,.10);
  --mb-chart-ink: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface);           /* the actual line */
  --mb-chart-grid: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high);
  --mb-chart-axis: var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant);
  --mb-chart-label: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant);
  --mb-chart-future: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-low);

  /* ---- Typography: M3 type scale on the system sans ------------------------------------ */
  --md-ref-typeface-plain: "Inter", "Public Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
  --md-ref-typeface-brand: var(--md-ref-typeface-plain);
  --md-ref-typeface-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;
  --md-sys-typescale-display-large: 400 57px/64px var(--md-ref-typeface-brand);
  --md-sys-typescale-display-medium: 400 45px/52px var(--md-ref-typeface-brand);
  --md-sys-typescale-display-small: 400 36px/44px var(--md-ref-typeface-brand);
  --md-sys-typescale-headline-large: 600 32px/40px var(--md-ref-typeface-brand);
  --md-sys-typescale-headline-medium: 600 28px/36px var(--md-ref-typeface-brand);
  --md-sys-typescale-headline-small: 600 24px/32px var(--md-ref-typeface-brand);
  --md-sys-typescale-title-large: 600 22px/28px var(--md-ref-typeface-brand);
  --md-sys-typescale-title-medium: 600 16px/24px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain);
  --md-sys-typescale-title-small: 600 14px/20px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain);
  --md-sys-typescale-body-large: 400 16px/24px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain);
  --md-sys-typescale-body-medium: 400 14px/22px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain);
  --md-sys-typescale-body-small: 400 12.5px/18px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain);
  --md-sys-typescale-label-large: 500 14px/20px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain);
  --md-sys-typescale-label-medium: 500 12.5px/16px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain);
  --md-sys-typescale-label-small: 500 11px/16px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain);
  --md-sys-typescale-label-large-tracking: 0.1px;
  --md-sys-typescale-label-medium-tracking: 0.3px;
  --md-sys-typescale-label-small-tracking: 0.4px;
  --md-sys-typescale-title-medium-tracking: 0.1px;
  --md-sys-typescale-body-medium-tracking: 0.15px;
  --md-sys-typescale-body-small-tracking: 0.3px;

  /* ---- Shape ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --md-sys-shape-corner-none: 0;
  --md-sys-shape-corner-extra-small: 2px;
  --md-sys-shape-corner-small: 4px;
  --md-sys-shape-corner-medium: 4px;
  --md-sys-shape-corner-large: 8px;
  --md-sys-shape-corner-extra-large: 12px;
  --md-sys-shape-corner-full: 9999px;
  --mb-card-radius: 4px;         /* cards: sharp corners (owner, 13 Oct 2026) */
  --mb-panel-radius: 4px;        /* tiles and columns inside a card */
  --mb-card-border: 1px solid transparent;   /* cards are lifted by a shadow, not a hairline */
  --mb-card-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(47, 51, 73, .08), 0 0 1px rgba(47, 51, 73, .14);
  --mb-card-shadow-hover: 0 6px 18px rgba(47, 51, 73, .12), 0 0 1px rgba(47, 51, 73, .14);

  /* ---- Elevation (soft, template-like) --------------------------------------------------- */
  --md-sys-elevation-0: none;
  --md-sys-elevation-1: var(--mb-card-shadow);
  --md-sys-elevation-2: 0 4px 14px rgba(47, 51, 73, .12), 0 0 1px rgba(47, 51, 73, .16);
  --md-sys-elevation-3: 0 8px 24px rgba(47, 51, 73, .16), 0 0 1px rgba(47, 51, 73, .18);
  --md-sys-elevation-4: 0 12px 32px rgba(47, 51, 73, .18);
  --md-sys-elevation-5: 0 16px 40px rgba(47, 51, 73, .22);

  /* ---- State layers --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --md-sys-state-hover-opacity: .08;
  --md-sys-state-focus-opacity: .10;
  --md-sys-state-pressed-opacity: .10;
  --md-sys-state-dragged-opacity: .16;
  --md-sys-state-disabled-opacity: .38;
  --md-sys-state-disabled-container-opacity: .12;

  /* ---- Spacing (4px grid) and layout ---------------------------------------------------- */
  --mb-space-1: 4px; --mb-space-2: 8px; --mb-space-3: 12px; --mb-space-4: 16px; --mb-space-5: 20px;
  --mb-space-6: 24px; --mb-space-8: 32px; --mb-space-10: 40px; --mb-space-12: 48px;
  --mb-gutter: 16px;            /* phone side gutter (never less) */
  --mb-gutter-desktop: 24px;
  --mb-content-max: 1240px;
  --mb-sidebar-width: 256px;    /* vertical menu with labels (>= 1200px) */
  --mb-rail-width: 76px;        /* collapsed menu, icons only (600-1199px) */
  --mb-navbar-height: 72px;     /* navigation bar (phone) */
  --mb-topbar-height: 64px;
  /* platform shell (design/PLATFORM_DESIGN.md section 2): app bar, navigation rail, watchlist panel, right drawer */
  --mb-appbar-height: 60px;
  --mb-navrail-width: 84px;     /* rail with labels under the icons; 64px when compact (icons only) */
  --mb-navrail-compact: 64px;
  --mb-wl-width: 300px;         /* watchlist panel (>= 1200px; an overlay below) */
  --mb-drawer-width: 420px;     /* right drawer: Paper order window, quick views (a bottom sheet on phones) */

  /* ---- Motion --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --md-sys-motion-duration-short: 120ms;
  --md-sys-motion-duration-medium: 250ms;
  --md-sys-motion-easing-standard: cubic-bezier(.2, 0, 0, 1);

  /* ---- Focus ring ----------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --mb-focus-ring: 0 0 0 2px var(--md-sys-color-surface), 0 0 0 4px var(--md-sys-color-primary);
}

/* Type role utility classes (apply to any element) */
.md-display-large { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-display-large); letter-spacing: -0.25px; }
.md-display-medium { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-display-medium); }
.md-display-small { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-display-small); }
.md-headline-large { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-headline-large); }
.md-headline-medium { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-headline-medium); }
.md-headline-small { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-headline-small); }
.md-title-large { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-title-large); }
.md-title-medium { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-title-medium); letter-spacing: var(--md-sys-typescale-title-medium-tracking); }
.md-title-small { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-title-small); letter-spacing: 0.1px; }
.md-body-large { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-large); letter-spacing: 0.3px; }
.md-body-medium { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-medium); letter-spacing: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-medium-tracking); }
.md-body-small { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); letter-spacing: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small-tracking); }
.md-label-large { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-large); letter-spacing: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-large-tracking); }
.md-label-medium { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-medium); letter-spacing: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-medium-tracking); }
.md-label-small { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-small); letter-spacing: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-small-tracking); }
.md-numeric { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.md-micro { font: 500 11px/16px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }

/* Omenix cockpit: DARK colour roles of the design tokens (generated by design/system/dark_tokens.py; edit
   the DARK table there and rerun). Same token names as tokens.css, colour roles only. Loaded after tokens.css: the
   web app imports its copy (web/tools/sync-design.mjs). Applies when the reader's system asks for dark (unless the page sets
   data-theme="light") or when the page sets data-theme="dark". Every text pair is WCAG AA (4.5:1), checked by
   `python design/system/dark_tokens.py --check`. */
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --md-sys-color-primary: #a8aafa;
  --md-sys-color-on-primary: #1d1f45;
  --md-sys-color-primary-container: #3a3d73;
  --md-sys-color-on-primary-container: #d4d5ff;
  --md-sys-color-secondary: #a3a9bd;
  --md-sys-color-on-secondary: #25293c;
  --md-sys-color-secondary-container: #3b4057;
  --md-sys-color-on-secondary-container: #d7d9e6;
  --md-sys-color-tertiary: #b9a3fb;
  --md-sys-color-on-tertiary: #2a1d52;
  --md-sys-color-tertiary-container: #3d3170;
  --md-sys-color-on-tertiary-container: #ddd2ff;
  --md-sys-color-error: #fb8585;
  --md-sys-color-on-error: #3b0d0d;
  --md-sys-color-error-container: #4c2429;
  --md-sys-color-on-error-container: #fecaca;
  --md-sys-color-surface: #2f3349;
  --md-sys-color-on-surface: #dfe0ec;
  --md-sys-color-surface-variant: #363b53;
  --md-sys-color-on-surface-variant: #bac0d2;
  --md-sys-color-surface-dim: #25293c;
  --md-sys-color-surface-bright: #3b4057;
  --md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest: #2f3349;
  --md-sys-color-surface-container-low: #25293c;
  --md-sys-color-surface-container: #363b53;
  --md-sys-color-surface-container-high: #3d4259;
  --md-sys-color-surface-container-highest: #464c66;
  --md-sys-color-outline: #7a809a;
  --md-sys-color-outline-variant: #464c66;
  --md-sys-color-inverse-surface: #e7e8f0;
  --md-sys-color-inverse-on-surface: #2f3349;
  --md-sys-color-inverse-primary: #5a5ee6;
  --md-sys-color-surface-tint: #a8aafa;
  --md-sys-color-background: #25293c;
  --md-sys-color-on-background: #dfe0ec;
  --md-sys-color-scrim: #000000;
  --md-sys-color-shadow: #000000;
  --mb-sidebar-bg: #1f2233;
  --mb-sidebar-ink: #d7d8e5;
  --mb-sidebar-muted: #a3a7bd;
  --mb-color-up: #4ade80;
  --mb-color-on-up: #0b2a17;
  --mb-color-up-container: #1e3d2c;
  --mb-color-on-up-container: #a7f3c0;
  --mb-color-down: #fb8585;
  --mb-color-on-down: #3b0d0d;
  --mb-color-down-container: #4c2429;
  --mb-color-on-down-container: #fecaca;
  --mb-color-neutral: #a3a9bd;
  --mb-color-on-neutral: #25293c;
  --mb-color-neutral-container: #3b4057;
  --mb-color-on-neutral-container: #d7d9e6;
  --mb-color-warn: #f5a524;
  --mb-color-on-warn: #2e1c00;
  --mb-color-warn-container: #4a3517;
  --mb-color-on-warn-container: #fcd88a;
  --mb-color-info: #38bdd3;
  --mb-color-info-container: #173f49;
  --mb-color-on-info-container: #a5ecf6;
  --mb-verdict-no-bg: #4c2429;
  --mb-verdict-no-box: #fb8585;
  --mb-verdict-no-ink: #fecaca;
  --mb-verdict-strong-bg: #1b5232;
  --mb-verdict-strong-box: #4ade80;
  --mb-verdict-strong-ink: #d1fadf;
  --mb-verdict-ok-bg: #1e3d2c;
  --mb-verdict-ok-box: #22c55e;
  --mb-verdict-ok-ink: #a7f3c0;
  --mb-color-backtest-container: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(154,156,248,.18) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px);
  --mb-chart-1: #9a9cf8;
  --mb-chart-2: #f5a524;
  --mb-chart-3: #38bdd3;
  --mb-chart-4: #f06aae;
  --mb-chart-1-fill: rgba(154,156,248,.32);
  --mb-chart-2-fill: rgba(245,165,36,.26);

  --mb-chart-band-50: rgba(154,156,248,.40);
  --mb-chart-band-80: rgba(154,156,248,.18);
  --mb-chart-fan: rgba(154,156,248,.14);

}

    color-scheme: dark;

    --md-sys-color-on-primary: #1d1f45;

    --md-sys-color-on-tertiary: #2a1d52;
    --md-sys-color-tertiary-container: #3d3170;
    --md-sys-color-on-tertiary-container: #ddd2ff;
    --md-sys-color-error: #fb8585;
    --md-sys-color-on-error: #3b0d0d;
    --md-sys-color-error-container: #4c2429;
    --md-sys-color-on-error-container: #fecaca;
    --md-sys-color-surface: #2f3349;
    --md-sys-color-on-surface: #dfe0ec;
    --md-sys-color-surface-variant: #363b53;
    --md-sys-color-on-surface-variant: #bac0d2;
    --md-sys-color-surface-dim: #25293c;
    --md-sys-color-surface-bright: #3b4057;
    --md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest: #2f3349;

/* Omenix cockpit: components on tokens.css, scheme v2 "modern admin light". Plain CSS, no JS

   Prefix: md- for M3 components, mb- for the cockpit's own (app shell, provenance tags, odds meter,

/* ---- Base ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-low); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }

.vh { position: absolute !important; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }

/* ---- Icons (Material Symbols Outlined, inlined from icons.svg) ------------------------- */
.ms { width: 1em; height: 1em; display: inline-block; vertical-align: -0.15em; fill: currentColor; flex: none; }
.ms-20 { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ms-24 { width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ms-40 { width: 40px; height: 40px; }

/* ---- App shell: semi-dark sidebar (>= 1200px), collapsed rail (600-1199px), phone bar + drawer ---- */

.mb-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 42px; padding: 0 var(--mb-space-3); border: 0; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); background: none; color: var(--mb-sidebar-ink); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-large); letter-spacing: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-large-tracking); white-space: nowrap; transition: background var(--md-sys-motion-duration-short); }

.mb-sidebar-foot { margin-top: auto; padding: var(--mb-space-3); border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); color: var(--mb-sidebar-muted); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); }
.mb-sidebar-foot b { color: var(--mb-sidebar-ink); }
.mb-navbar { display: none; }
.mb-menu-btn { display: none; }
.mb-scrim { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(47,51,73,.45); z-index: 29; }
.mb-topbar { grid-column: 2; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; height: var(--mb-topbar-height); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--mb-space-3); padding: 0 var(--mb-gutter-desktop); }

.mb-content { grid-column: 2; min-width: 0; padding: 0 var(--mb-gutter-desktop) var(--mb-space-12); }

@media (max-width: 1199px) {

}
@media (max-width: 599px) {

  .mb-sidebar, .mb-rail { position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: var(--mb-sidebar-width); z-index: 30; transform: translateX(-100%); transition: transform var(--md-sys-motion-duration-medium) var(--md-sys-motion-easing-standard); padding: var(--mb-space-4) var(--mb-space-3); align-items: stretch; box-shadow: var(--md-sys-elevation-3); }
  .mb-sidebar.open, .mb-rail.open { transform: none; }

  .mb-sidebar .mb-nav-item { width: auto; justify-content: flex-start; padding: 0 var(--mb-space-3); }
  .mb-sidebar-brand { padding: 0 var(--mb-space-2); justify-content: flex-start; }
  .mb-menu-btn { display: inline-grid; }
  .mb-topbar, .mb-content { grid-column: 1; }
  .mb-topbar { padding: 0 var(--mb-gutter); gap: var(--mb-space-2); }
  .mb-search { min-width: 0; width: 38px; padding: 0; justify-content: center; }

  .mb-navbar .mb-nav-item { flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; height: auto; width: auto; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; padding: 6px 0; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); background: none; box-shadow: none; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-small); }

/* ---- Cards ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.md-card { border-radius: var(--mb-card-radius); padding: var(--mb-space-5) var(--mb-space-6); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest); box-shadow: var(--mb-card-shadow); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); }

/* Icon tile (avatar): a tinted rounded square with an icon, the admin-template KPI signature */
.mb-avatar { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 4px; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; background: var(--md-sys-color-primary-container); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-primary-container); }

.mb-avatar.neutral { background: var(--mb-color-neutral-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-neutral-container); }

.mb-avatar.sm { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 4px; } .mb-avatar.sm .ms { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.mb-avatar.lg { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 4px; } .mb-avatar.lg .ms { width: 28px; height: 28px; }

/* ---- Buttons -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.md-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--mb-space-2); height: 38px; padding: 0 var(--mb-space-4); border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); border: 0; cursor: pointer; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-large); letter-spacing: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-large-tracking); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; position: relative; background: transparent; color: var(--md-sys-color-primary); }

.md-btn.outlined { border: 1px solid var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); }

.md-btn:disabled, .md-btn[aria-disabled="true"] { cursor: not-allowed; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--md-sys-color-on-surface) 38%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--md-sys-color-on-surface) 12%, transparent); border-color: transparent; box-shadow: none; }

.mb-label.info { background: var(--mb-color-info-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-info-container); }

/* ---- Provenance tags: Live / Back-test / Mock / Paper / Derived (texture + colour) ------ */
.mb-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 3px; padding: 4px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest); white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: middle; }

.mb-tag.coming { border-style: dashed; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }
.md-chip.live .sw { background: var(--mb-color-live); }
.md-chip.bt .sw { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--mb-color-backtest) 0 2px, #fff 2px 4px); border: 1px solid var(--mb-color-backtest); }
.md-chip.mock .sw { border: 1.5px dashed var(--mb-color-mock); background: transparent; }

/* ---- Status badges (never colour alone: always an icon or glyph plus the word) ---------- */
.md-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font: 500 11.5px/16px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .02em; border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px 7px; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container); white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: middle; }
.md-badge .ms { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.md-badge.dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--md-sys-color-error); }
.md-badge.count { min-width: 16px; height: 16px; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-full); background: var(--md-sys-color-error); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-error); justify-content: center; }
.mb-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-weight: 600; }
.mb-status.up, .mb-status.hit { color: var(--mb-color-up); }
.mb-status.down, .mb-status.miss { color: var(--mb-color-down); }
.mb-status.neutral { color: var(--mb-color-neutral); }
.mb-status.unknown { color: var(--mb-color-on-warn-container); }
.md-badge.up, .md-badge.hit, .md-badge.confirmed_primary, .md-badge.corroborated { color: var(--mb-color-on-up-container); background: var(--mb-color-up-container); }
.md-badge.down, .md-badge.miss, .md-badge.rumour, .md-badge.contradicted, .md-badge.promotional { color: var(--mb-color-on-down-container); background: var(--mb-color-down-container); }
.md-badge.warn, .md-badge.single_source { color: var(--mb-color-on-warn-container); background: var(--mb-color-warn-container); }
.md-badge.neutral, .md-badge.unverified { color: var(--mb-color-on-neutral-container); background: var(--mb-color-neutral-container); }
/* Square direction / sentiment markers: container tone with an on-container glyph */
.mb-dir { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 3px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none; }
.mb-dir .ms { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.mb-dir.up { background: var(--mb-color-up-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-up-container); }
.mb-dir.dn, .mb-dir.down { background: var(--mb-color-down-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-down-container); }
.mb-dir.flat, .mb-dir.neutral { background: var(--mb-color-neutral-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-neutral-container); }
.mb-dir.unk { background: var(--mb-color-warn-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-warn-container); }
/* Round outcome markers: solid tone with a white glyph (strong, for ticks and crosses) */
.mb-mark { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; flex: none; }
.mb-mark .ms { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.mb-mark.ok, .mb-mark.hit { background: var(--mb-color-hit); }
.mb-mark.no, .mb-mark.miss { background: var(--mb-color-miss); }
.mb-mark.na { background: var(--mb-color-neutral); }

/* ---- Tooltip (plain, M3: inverse surface) --------------------------------------------- */
.md-tooltip { position: fixed; z-index: 50; max-width: min(320px, calc(100vw - 24px)); background: var(--md-sys-color-inverse-surface); color: var(--md-sys-color-inverse-on-surface); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); letter-spacing: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small-tracking); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); box-shadow: var(--md-sys-elevation-3); pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--md-sys-motion-duration-short); }
.md-tooltip.on { opacity: 1; }
.md-tooltip b { color: var(--md-sys-color-inverse-on-surface); }
.md-tooltip .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; }
.md-tooltip .row span:last-child { font-weight: 600; }
.md-tooltip .dim { color: var(--mb-sidebar-muted); margin-top: 4px; }
.md-tooltip-rich { background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-medium); padding: var(--mb-space-3) var(--mb-space-4); box-shadow: var(--md-sys-elevation-2); max-width: 320px; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-medium); }
.md-tooltip-rich .subhead { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-title-small); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); margin-bottom: 4px; }

/* ---- Data tables ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.md-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-medium); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.md-table th { font: 600 11px/16px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); text-align: left; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container); white-space: nowrap; }
.md-table th:first-child { border-radius: 0; } .md-table th:last-child { border-radius: 0; }
.md-table td { padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); vertical-align: middle; }
.md-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.md-table tr:hover td { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--md-sys-color-primary) 4%, transparent); }
.md-table td.num, .md-table th.num { text-align: right; }
.md-table tr.muted td { color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-low); }
.md-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }

/* ---- Lists, key-value, dividers -------------------------------------------------------- */
.md-divider { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); margin: var(--mb-space-4) 0; }
.md-kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 4px 14px; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-medium); margin: 0; }
.md-kv dt { color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); } .md-kv dd { margin: 0; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.md-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.md-list > li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: var(--mb-space-3); align-items: center; padding: var(--mb-space-3) 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); }
.md-list > li:first-child { border-top: 0; }

/* ---- Progress and the odds meter ------------------------------------------------------- */
.md-progress { height: 6px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-full); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); overflow: hidden; }
.md-progress > i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--md-sys-color-primary); border-radius: inherit; }
.mb-odds { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.mb-odds svg { width: 64px; height: 14px; display: block; }
.mb-odds b { font-weight: 600; min-width: 30px; }
.mb-odds .track { fill: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); }
.mb-odds .mid { stroke: var(--md-sys-color-outline); }
.mb-odds .dot { stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 1.5; } .mb-odds .dot.up { fill: var(--mb-color-up); } .mb-odds .dot.dn { fill: var(--mb-color-down); }
.mb-bar { height: 8px; background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); border-radius: 4px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.mb-bar i { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 4px; }
.mb-bar i.up { background: var(--mb-color-up); left: 50%; } .mb-bar i.dn { background: var(--mb-color-down); right: 50%; } .mb-bar i.unk { background: var(--mb-color-warn); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
.mb-bar::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -2px; bottom: -2px; width: 1px; background: var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant); }

/* ---- KPI card (stat card with an icon tile, label, big number and a trend label) --------- */
.mb-kpi { border-radius: var(--mb-card-radius); padding: var(--mb-space-5); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest); box-shadow: var(--mb-card-shadow); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 6px 12px; align-items: start; min-width: 0; }
.mb-kpi .l { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }
.mb-kpi .v { font: 700 26px/1.15 var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: -.5px; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.mb-kpi .s { grid-column: 1 / span 2; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.mb-kpi .mb-avatar { grid-row: 1 / span 2; }
.mb-kpi.accent { background: var(--md-sys-color-primary); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-primary); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(90,94,230,.35); }
.mb-kpi.accent .l, .mb-kpi.accent .s, .mb-kpi.accent .v { color: inherit; } .mb-kpi.accent .l { opacity: .85; }
.mb-kpi.accent .mb-avatar { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); color: #fff; }

/* ---- Details / expansion -------------------------------------------------------------- */
details.md-expansion { background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest); box-shadow: var(--mb-card-shadow); border-radius: var(--mb-card-radius); padding: 0 var(--mb-space-6); }
details.md-expansion summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 16px 0; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-title-small); list-style: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--mb-space-2); }
details.md-expansion summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
details.md-expansion summary::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-right: 2px solid var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); transform: rotate(-45deg); transition: transform .15s; margin-right: 4px; flex: none; }
details.md-expansion[open] summary::before { transform: rotate(45deg); }
details.md-expansion .inner { padding: 0 0 18px; }

/* ---- Code / preformatted ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
.md-pre { background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container); border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); padding: 10px; font: 11.5px/1.45 var(--md-ref-typeface-mono); overflow: auto; max-height: 320px; margin: 0; }

/* ---- Verdict header (decision pages): NO red; YES green, darker when strong, lighter when okay ---- */
.mb-verdict { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 18px 22px; padding: 20px 22px; align-items: center; border-radius: var(--mb-card-radius); }
.mb-verdict .mb-verdict-box { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-medium); color: #fff; display: grid; place-items: center; }

.mb-verdict .mb-verdict-word small { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .02em; margin-top: 6px; }
.mb-verdict.no { background: var(--mb-verdict-no-bg); color: var(--mb-verdict-no-ink); } .mb-verdict.no .mb-verdict-box { background: var(--mb-verdict-no-box); }
.mb-verdict.yes-strong { background: var(--mb-verdict-strong-bg); color: var(--mb-verdict-strong-ink); } .mb-verdict.yes-strong .mb-verdict-box { background: var(--mb-verdict-strong-box); }
.mb-verdict.yes-ok { background: var(--mb-verdict-ok-bg); color: var(--mb-verdict-ok-ink); } .mb-verdict.yes-ok .mb-verdict-box { background: var(--mb-verdict-ok-box); }
/* Signed number: green/red with its sign (the sign is the glyph) */
.mb-delta { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .mb-delta.up { color: var(--mb-color-up); } .mb-delta.down { color: var(--mb-color-down); } .mb-delta.flat { color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }
/* Uppercase micro label (section eyebrows, table headers, stat labels) */
.mb-micro { font: 500 11px/16px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }

/* ---- Alert band (template "alert": a tint with an icon, a title and a line of text) ------ */
.mb-alert { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: var(--mb-card-radius); background: var(--mb-color-warn-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-warn-container); }
.mb-alert.info { background: var(--md-sys-color-primary-container); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-primary-container); }
.mb-alert.success { background: var(--mb-color-up-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-up-container); }
.mb-alert.danger { background: var(--mb-color-down-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-down-container); }
.mb-alert b.t { display: block; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-title-small); }
.mb-alert .s { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); margin-top: 2px; opacity: .92; }
.mb-alert .ms { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

/* ======================================================================================== */
/* ---- Platform shell (design/PLATFORM_DESIGN.md section 2, 12 Oct 2026) --------------------
   A broker-style frame: app bar on top (brand, global search, market switch, index strip, bell, theme, profile),
   a dark navy navigation rail (icons with labels, group flyouts, pinned screens), a Kite-style watchlist panel, the
   page, and a right drawer (Paper order window, quick views) that becomes a bottom sheet on phones. Phone: bottom tabs
   (.mb-navbar), search on top. Classes: .mb-pf (grid), .mb-appbar, .mb-navrail, .mb-wl, .mb-pf-main, .mb-drawer,
   .mb-veil, .mb-hcard, .mb-modal (.palette), .mb-menu, .mb-snack. Breakpoints: >= 1200 rail + watchlist + page;
   600-1199 rail + page (watchlist as an overlay); < 600 phone. */
.mb-pf { min-height: 100vh; display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--mb-navrail-width) var(--mb-wl-width) minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: var(--mb-appbar-height) minmax(0, 1fr); }
.mb-pf.wl-off { grid-template-columns: var(--mb-navrail-width) minmax(0, 1fr); }
.mb-pf.wl-off > .mb-wl { display: none; }
.mb-pf-main { grid-row: 2; min-width: 0; padding: 0 var(--mb-gutter-desktop) var(--mb-space-12); }
.mb-pf-main > .mb-pf-inner { max-width: var(--mb-content-max); margin: 0 auto; }

/* app bar */
.mb-appbar { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 1; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 25; height: var(--mb-appbar-height); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--mb-space-3); padding: 0 var(--mb-space-4) 0 0; background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); }
.mb-appbar.scrolled { box-shadow: var(--md-sys-elevation-2); }
.mb-appbar-brand { width: var(--mb-navrail-width); height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; background: var(--mb-sidebar-bg); color: #fff; text-decoration: none; flex: none; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-title-medium); }
.mb-appbar-brand .mb-brand-mark, .mb-legal-brand .mb-brand-mark { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--mb-brand-tile); box-shadow: var(--mb-sidebar-active-shadow); display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; }
.mb-brand-mark .mb-logo { width: 72%; height: 72%; display: block; }   /* the logo's own margin inside its tile (design/brand/desktop/tile.svg) */
.mb-appbar-name { font: 700 18px/1 var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: -.3px; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); white-space: nowrap; }
.mb-appbar-name small { display: block; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-small); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); letter-spacing: .2px; margin-top: 3px; }
.mb-appbar-end { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--mb-space-1); flex: none; }
.mb-gsearch { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; width: auto; flex: 1 1 220px; max-width: 420px; min-width: 0; padding: 0 8px 0 14px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-medium); cursor: text; text-align: left; }
.mb-gsearch:hover { border-color: var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant); }
.mb-gsearch .ms { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; }
.mb-gsearch .sm { display: none; }
.mb-gsearch > span:not(.mb-kbd) { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.mb-kbd { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant); border-bottom-width: 2px; background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); font: 600 11px/1 var(--md-ref-typeface-mono); white-space: nowrap; flex: none; }
/* index strip: name, value, signed change; the as-of time in its tooltip */
.mb-idx-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--mb-space-1); min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.mb-idx { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; gap: 0 8px; align-items: baseline; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); text-decoration: none; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); white-space: nowrap; }
.mb-idx:hover { background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-low); }
.mb-idx .n { grid-column: 1 / span 2; font: 600 10.5px/14px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }
.mb-idx .v { font: 600 13.5px/18px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.mb-idx .mb-delta { font-size: 12px; }
.mb-idx.stale .v, .mb-idx.stale .mb-delta { color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }
/* market status chip: open (green) or closed (grey), always with the word and the next time; your own buy and sell
   are paused while it is closed */
.mb-mkt { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); white-space: nowrap; flex: none; }
.mb-mkt i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mb-color-neutral); flex: none; }
.mb-mkt b { font-weight: 700; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); }
.mb-mkt.open { background: var(--mb-color-up-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-up-container); }
.mb-mkt.open i { background: var(--mb-color-up); } .mb-mkt.open b { color: var(--mb-color-on-up-container); }
.mb-me { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; border: 0; background: var(--md-sys-color-tertiary-container); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-tertiary-container); font: 700 13px/1 var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); display: inline-grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; margin-left: var(--mb-space-1); }
.mb-badged { position: relative; }
.mb-badged > .md-badge.count { position: absolute; top: 4px; right: 3px; font-size: 10px; min-width: 16px; }

/* navigation rail: dark navy, icon over label, the active group a gradient pill; hover or focus opens the group's flyout */
.mb-navrail { grid-row: 2; position: sticky; top: var(--mb-appbar-height); height: calc(100vh - var(--mb-appbar-height)); z-index: 22; background: var(--mb-sidebar-bg); color: var(--mb-sidebar-ink); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: var(--mb-space-3) 0; }
.mb-rail-grp { position: relative; width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: center; }

.mb-rail-item .mb-nav-ind { width: 44px; height: 30px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); display: grid; place-items: center; transition: background var(--md-sys-motion-duration-short); }
.mb-rail-item .ms { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
.mb-rail-item:hover .mb-nav-ind, .mb-rail-grp:focus-within .mb-rail-item .mb-nav-ind { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mb-sidebar-ink) 12%, transparent); }
.mb-rail-item[aria-current="page"] { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }

.mb-rail-sep { width: 40px; height: 1px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mb-sidebar-ink) 18%, transparent); margin: var(--mb-space-2) 0; flex: none; }
.mb-rail-pins-t { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; font: 600 10px/14px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mb-sidebar-muted); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.mb-rail-pins-t .ms { width: 12px; height: 12px; }
.mb-rail-pin { width: 72px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 5px 2px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); color: var(--mb-sidebar-ink); text-decoration: none; font: 500 10.5px/13px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.mb-rail-pin .ms { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--mb-sidebar-muted); }
.mb-rail-pin:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mb-sidebar-ink) 12%, transparent); color: #fff; }
.mb-rail-fly { display: none; position: absolute; left: calc(100% - 4px); top: -4px; z-index: 40; min-width: 230px; padding: var(--mb-space-2); border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-medium); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); box-shadow: var(--md-sys-elevation-3); }

<h2>What Omenix is</h2>

<h2>Who can use it</h2>

<p>It never opens, reads, changes, shares or deletes anything outside that folder, never deletes or shares any file, and receives no Google profile, contacts or e-mail data.   --mb-color-on-up: #ffffff;

  --mb-color-on-info-container: #0c5d6b;

  --mb-color-hit-container: var(--mb-color-up-container);
  --mb-color-on-hit-container: var(--mb-color-on-up-container);
  --mb-color-miss: var(--mb-color-down);
  --mb-color-miss-container: var(--mb-color-down-container);
  --mb-color-on-miss-container: var(--mb-color-on-down-container);

  --mb-color-live-container: var(--mb-color-up-container);

/* ---- Base ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

.mb-navbar { display: none; }

.mb-search { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); text-decoration: none; min-width: 200px; }

/* ---- Cards ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.mb-avatar.lg { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 4px; } .mb-avatar.lg .ms { width: 28px; height: 28px; }

/* ---- Buttons -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.md-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--mb-space-2); height: 38px; padding: 0 var(--mb-space-4); border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); border: 0; cursor: pointer; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-large); letter-spacing: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-large-tracking); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; position: relative; background: transparent; color: var(--md-sys-color-primary); }

/* Help affordance: a small outlined icon button that opens a tooltip (hover, focus or tap) */
.md-help { appearance: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-small); letter-spacing: 0; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; cursor: help; padding: 0; vertical-align: middle; margin-left: 4px; line-height: 1; }
.md-help:hover, .md-help:focus-visible { border-color: var(--md-sys-color-primary); color: var(--md-sys-color-primary); }

/* ---- Segmented buttons (pill tabs) ------------------------------------------------------ */

.md-segmented > [aria-pressed="true"], .md-segmented > [aria-current="true"] { background: var(--md-sys-color-primary); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-primary); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(90,94,230,.35); font-weight: 600; }

.md-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--mb-space-2); height: 30px; padding: 0 var(--mb-space-3); border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); border: 1px solid var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-medium); letter-spacing: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-medium-tracking); white-space: nowrap; cursor: default; }

.md-chip.small { height: 24px; padding: 0 var(--mb-space-2); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-small); } .md-chip.small .ms { width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-left: -2px; }

/* ---- Labels (template "label" badges: a tint with its ink, rounded) --------------------- */
.mb-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font: 600 12px/18px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .1px; border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--md-sys-color-primary-container); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-primary-container); white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: middle; }

.mb-label.success, .mb-label.up { background: var(--mb-color-up-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-up-container); }
.mb-label.danger, .mb-label.down { background: var(--mb-color-down-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-down-container); }
.mb-label.warn { background: var(--mb-color-warn-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-warn-container); }
.mb-label.info { background: var(--mb-color-info-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-info-container); }
.mb-label.neutral { background: var(--mb-color-neutral-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-neutral-container); }
.mb-label.paper { background: var(--mb-color-paper-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-paper-container); }

.mb-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 3px; padding: 4px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest); white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: middle; }
.mb-tag .ms { width: 12px; height: 12px; }

.mb-tag.bt, .mb-tag.backtest { background: var(--mb-color-backtest-container), var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest); border-color: var(--mb-color-backtest); color: var(--mb-color-on-backtest-container); }

.mb-tag.coming { border-style: dashed; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }
.md-chip.live .sw { background: var(--mb-color-live); }
.md-chip.bt .sw { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--mb-color-backtest) 0 2px, #fff 2px 4px); border: 1px solid var(--mb-color-backtest); }
.md-chip.mock .sw { border: 1.5px dashed var(--mb-color-mock); background: transparent; }

/* ---- Status badges (never colour alone: always an icon or glyph plus the word) ---------- */
.md-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font: 500 11.5px/16px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .02em; border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px 7px; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container); white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: middle; }
.md-badge .ms { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

.md-badge.count { min-width: 16px; height: 16px; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-full); background: var(--md-sys-color-error); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-error); justify-content: center; }

.md-badge.up, .md-badge.hit, .md-badge.confirmed_primary, .md-badge.corroborated { color: var(--mb-color-on-up-container); background: var(--mb-color-up-container); }
.md-badge.down, .md-badge.miss, .md-badge.rumour, .md-badge.contradicted, .md-badge.promotional { color: var(--mb-color-on-down-container); background: var(--mb-color-down-container); }
.md-badge.warn, .md-badge.single_source { color: var(--mb-color-on-warn-container); background: var(--mb-color-warn-container); }
.md-badge.neutral, .md-badge.unverified { color: var(--mb-color-on-neutral-container); background: var(--mb-color-neutral-container); }
/* Square direction / sentiment markers: container tone with an on-container glyph */
.mb-dir { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 3px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none; }

.mb-mark { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; flex: none; }
.mb-mark .ms { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.mb-mark.ok, .mb-mark.hit { background: var(--mb-color-hit); }
.mb-mark.no, .mb-mark.miss { background: var(--mb-color-miss); }

/* ---- Tooltip (plain, M3: inverse surface) --------------------------------------------- */
.md-tooltip { position: fixed; z-index: 50; max-width: min(320px, calc(100vw - 24px)); background: var(--md-sys-color-inverse-surface); color: var(--md-sys-color-inverse-on-surface); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); letter-spacing: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small-tracking); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); box-shadow: var(--md-sys-elevation-3); pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--md-sys-motion-duration-short); }

.md-tooltip .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; }
.md-tooltip .row span:last-child { font-weight: 600; }

/* ---- Data tables ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.md-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-medium); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.md-table th { font: 600 11px/16px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); text-align: left; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container); white-space: nowrap; }

.md-divider { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); margin: var(--mb-space-4) 0; }
.md-kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 4px 14px; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-medium); margin: 0; }
.md-kv dt { color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); } .md-kv dd { margin: 0; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
code { font-family: var(--md-ref-typeface-mono); font-size: .92em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.md-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.md-list > li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: var(--mb-space-3); align-items: center; padding: var(--mb-space-3) 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); }
.md-list > li:first-child { border-top: 0; }

/* ---- Progress and the odds meter ------------------------------------------------------- */
.md-progress { height: 6px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-full); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); overflow: hidden; }
.md-progress > i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--md-sys-color-primary); border-radius: inherit; }
.mb-odds { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.mb-odds svg { width: 64px; height: 14px; display: block; }
.mb-odds b { font-weight: 600; min-width: 30px; }
.mb-odds .track { fill: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); }
.mb-odds .mid { stroke: var(--md-sys-color-outline); }
.mb-odds .dot { stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 1.5; } .mb-odds .dot.up { fill: var(--mb-color-up); } .mb-odds .dot.dn { fill: var(--mb-color-down); }
.mb-bar { height: 8px; background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); border-radius: 4px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.mb-bar i { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 4px; }
.mb-bar i.up { background: var(--mb-color-up); left: 50%; } .mb-bar i.dn { background: var(--mb-color-down); right: 50%; } .mb-bar i.unk { background: var(--mb-color-warn); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
.mb-bar::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -2px; bottom: -2px; width: 1px; background: var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant); }

/* ---- KPI card (stat card with an icon tile, label, big number and a trend label) --------- */
.mb-kpi { border-radius: var(--mb-card-radius); padding: var(--mb-space-5); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest); box-shadow: var(--mb-card-shadow); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 6px 12px; align-items: start; min-width: 0; }
.mb-kpi .l { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }
.mb-kpi .v { font: 700 26px/1.15 var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: -.5px; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.mb-kpi .s { grid-column: 1 / span 2; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.mb-kpi .mb-avatar { grid-row: 1 / span 2; }
.mb-kpi.accent { background: var(--md-sys-color-primary); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-primary); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(90,94,230,.35); }
.mb-kpi.accent .l, .mb-kpi.accent .s, .mb-kpi.accent .v { color: inherit; } .mb-kpi.accent .l { opacity: .85; }
.mb-kpi.accent .mb-avatar { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); color: #fff; }

/* ---- Details / expansion -------------------------------------------------------------- */
details.md-expansion { background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest); box-shadow: var(--mb-card-shadow); border-radius: var(--mb-card-radius); padding: 0 var(--mb-space-6); }

/* ---- Code / preformatted ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
.md-pre { background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container); border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); padding: 10px; font: 11.5px/1.45 var(--md-ref-typeface-mono); overflow: auto; max-height: 320px; margin: 0; }

/* ---- Verdict header (decision pages): NO red; YES green, darker when strong, lighter when okay ---- */

.mb-verdict .mb-verdict-box { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-medium); color: #fff; display: grid; place-items: center; }

.mb-verdict.no { background: var(--mb-verdict-no-bg); color: var(--mb-verdict-no-ink); } .mb-verdict.no .mb-verdict-box { background: var(--mb-verdict-no-box); }
.mb-verdict.yes-strong { background: var(--mb-verdict-strong-bg); color: var(--mb-verdict-strong-ink); } .mb-verdict.yes-strong .mb-verdict-box { background: var(--mb-verdict-strong-box); }
.mb-verdict.yes-ok { background: var(--mb-verdict-ok-bg); color: var(--mb-verdict-ok-ink); } .mb-verdict.yes-ok .mb-verdict-box { background: var(--mb-verdict-ok-box); }
/* Signed number: green/red with its sign (the sign is the glyph) */
.mb-delta { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .mb-delta.up { color: var(--mb-color-up); } .mb-delta.down { color: var(--mb-color-down); } .mb-delta.flat { color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }

.mb-micro { font: 500 11px/16px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }

/* ---- Alert band (template "alert": a tint with an icon, a title and a line of text) ------ */
.mb-alert { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: var(--mb-card-radius); background: var(--mb-color-warn-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-warn-container); }

.mb-alert.danger { background: var(--mb-color-down-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-down-container); }
.mb-alert b.t { display: block; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-title-small); }
.mb-alert .s { font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); margin-top: 2px; opacity: .92; }
.mb-alert .ms { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

/* ---- Platform shell (design/PLATFORM_DESIGN.md section 2, 12 Oct 2026) --------------------
   A broker-style frame: app bar on top (brand, global search, market switch, index strip, bell, theme, profile),
   a dark navy navigation rail (icons with labels, group flyouts, pinned screens), a Kite-style watchlist panel, the
   page, and a right drawer (Paper order window, quick views) that becomes a bottom sheet on phones. Phone: bottom tabs
   (.mb-navbar), search on top. Classes: .mb-pf (grid), .mb-appbar, .mb-navrail, .mb-wl, .mb-pf-main, .mb-drawer,
   .mb-veil, .mb-hcard, .mb-modal (.palette), .mb-menu, .mb-snack. Breakpoints: >= 1200 rail + watchlist + page;
   600-1199 rail + page (watchlist as an overlay); < 600 phone. */
.mb-pf { min-height: 100vh; display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--mb-navrail-width) var(--mb-wl-width) minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: var(--mb-appbar-height) minmax(0, 1fr); }

.mb-pf-main > .mb-pf-inner { max-width: var(--mb-content-max); margin: 0 auto; }

.mb-appbar { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 1; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 25; height: var(--mb-appbar-height); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--mb-space-3); padding: 0 var(--mb-space-4) 0 0; background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); }

.mb-appbar-brand .mb-brand-mark, .mb-legal-brand .mb-brand-mark { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--mb-brand-tile); box-shadow: var(--mb-sidebar-active-shadow); display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; }

.mb-gsearch .ms { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; }

.mb-idx-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--mb-space-1); min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; }

.mb-idx .v { font: 600 13.5px/18px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.mb-idx .mb-delta { font-size: 12px; }
.mb-idx.stale .v, .mb-idx.stale .mb-delta { color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }
/* market status chip: open (green) or closed (grey), always with the word and the next time; your own buy and sell
   are paused while it is closed */
.mb-mkt { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); white-space: nowrap; flex: none; }
.mb-mkt i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mb-color-neutral); flex: none; }
.mb-mkt b { font-weight: 700; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); }
.mb-mkt.open { background: var(--mb-color-up-container); color: var(--mb-color-on-up-container); }
.mb-mkt.open i { background: var(--mb-color-up); } .mb-mkt.open b { color: var(--mb-color-on-up-container); }

.mb-badged { position: relative; }
.mb-badged > .md-badge.count { position: absolute; top: 4px; right: 3px; font-size: 10px; min-width: 16px; }

.mb-navrail { grid-row: 2; position: sticky; top: var(--mb-appbar-height); height: calc(100vh - var(--mb-appbar-height)); z-index: 22; background: var(--mb-sidebar-bg); color: var(--mb-sidebar-ink); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: var(--mb-space-3) 0; }

.mb-rail-pins-t .ms { width: 12px; height: 12px; }

.mb-rail-pin .ms { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--mb-sidebar-muted); }
.mb-rail-pin:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mb-sidebar-ink) 12%, transparent); color: #fff; }
.mb-rail-fly { display: none; position: absolute; left: calc(100% - 4px); top: -4px; z-index: 40; min-width: 230px; padding: var(--mb-space-2); border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-medium); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); box-shadow: var(--md-sys-elevation-3); }
.mb-rail-grp:hover > .mb-rail-fly, .mb-rail-grp:focus-within > .mb-rail-fly, .mb-rail-fly.on { display: block; }
.mb-rail-fly .t { font: 600 11px/16px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); padding: 6px 10px 4px; }
.mb-rail-fly a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); text-decoration: none; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-medium); white-space: nowrap; }
.mb-rail-fly a .ms { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }

.mb-rail-fly a small { margin-left: auto; color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-label-small); }
.mb-pf { --mb-rail-now: var(--mb-navrail-width); }   /* the rail's current width: full, or icons only */
.mb-pf.rail-compact { --mb-rail-now: var(--mb-navrail-compact); grid-template-columns: var(--mb-navrail-compact) var(--mb-wl-width) minmax(0, 1fr); }

.mb-pf.rail-compact .mb-rail-pins-t { font-size: 0; }
.mb-pf.rail-compact .mb-appbar-brand { width: var(--mb-navrail-compact); }

/* watchlist panel (Kite-style): tabs 1-5, a filter field, rows with price, change and as-of; hover or tap shows B S and more */
.mb-wl { grid-row: 2; position: sticky; top: var(--mb-appbar-height); height: calc(100vh - var(--mb-appbar-height)); z-index: 21; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); box-shadow: 1px 0 0 var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-high); }
.mb-wl-head { padding: var(--mb-space-3) var(--mb-space-3) var(--mb-space-2); display: grid; gap: var(--mb-space-2); }
.mb-wl-find { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 38px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small); background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }
.mb-wl-find input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-medium); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); outline: none; }
.mb-wl-find .ms { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; }
.mb-wl-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-small); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); }
.mb-wl-meta b { color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); font-weight: 600; }

.mb-wl-row:hover, .mb-wl-row:focus-within, .mb-wl-row.open { background: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container-low); }
.mb-wl-row .grip { color: var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant); width: 14px; height: 14px; cursor: grab; opacity: 0; }
.mb-wl-row:hover .grip { opacity: 1; }
.mb-wl-row .sym { font: 600 13.5px/18px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); overflow-wrap: anywhere; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.mb-wl-row .sym.down { color: var(--mb-color-down); } .mb-wl-row .sym.up { color: var(--mb-color-up); }
.mb-wl-row .sub { font: 11.5px/16px var(--md-ref-typeface-plain); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
